Bayonetta 2.name: Bayonetta 2
Bayonetta 2.summary: The witching hour strikes again. Brimming with intricate battles that take place in, on and all over epic set pieces, Bayonetta 2 finds our sassy heroine battling angels and demons in unearthly beautiful HD. You’re bound to love how it feels to string together combos with unimaginable weapons and to summon demons using Bayonetta’s Umbran Weave in this frantic stylized action game.

LEGO Batman 3 - Beyond Gotham.name: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham
LEGO Batman 3 - Beyond Gotham.summary: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham is an action-adventure game developed by TT Games and released in 2014. The game features Batman and other DC Comics characters traveling beyond Earth to stop the villain Brainiac. Players explore various locations, solve puzzles, and engage in combat while collecting LEGO studs and unlocking characters. The game includes a large roster of DC heroes and villains, each with unique abilities.

Runbow - Deluxe Edition.name: Runbow: Deluxe Edition
Runbow - Deluxe Edition.summary:
Runbow is a fast, frantic game that you can play with up to 9 people on the same console, or online with friends all around the world. Conquer over 140 levels in the single player Adventure, or go head to head in one of Runbow's four multiplayer modes. The world changes with each swipe of color, so you'll have to stay on your toes as platforms and obstacles disappear!

Runbow: Deluxe Edition includes:
- The original Game
- Satura's Space Adventure
- All DLC add-on packs
- Runbow OST Volumes 1 & 2.
